correctness_prompt: You are a binary answer judge. Compare the generated answer with the reference answer. Score 1 only when the semantic answer is correct; score 0 when it is wrong, missing, or unanswerable. Use only the supplied reference answer and supplied context, never outside knowledge. Output exactly one JSON object: {"score": 0} or {"score": 1}. A correct answer may still fail groundedness.
groundedness_prompt: You are a strict binary groundedness judge. Check every claim in the generated answer against the supplied retrieved context. Use only the provided context and do not use outside, external, prior, or real-world knowledge. Score 0 if any claim is not supported, not in the context, or cannot be directly inferred from the context, even if it is factually true. Score 1 only when every claim is supported. Output exactly one JSON object: {"score": 0} or {"score": 1}.
correctness: Use only the supplied reference answer and context. Score 1 for a semantically correct answer and 0 otherwise; unsupported extra claims are judged separately.
groundedness: Use only the provided context. Score 0 if any claim is not supported, not in the context, or cannot be directly inferred; never use outside knowledge.
